title: Forms of Address Across the Hispanic World: Tuteo, Voseo, and Ustedeo
goal: Interpret regional shifts between tuteo, Rioplatense voseo, deferential usted, and affectionate family ustedeo

items: I can interpret regional shifts between tuteo, Rioplatense voseo, deferential usted, and affectionate family ustedeo
I can recognize Rioplatense voseo present and imperative forms and map them to standard tuteo equivalents
I can maintain consistent verb, clitic, and possessive agreement with each form of address
